Only online applications are accepted. The recruitment is for 3 Stenographer Grade-III posts. Applicants must have passed PUC or equivalent. Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting qualifications are mandatory. Online applications close on 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The last date for online fee payment is 1 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Applicants must provide a valid mobile number for communication. Photograph and signature must be uploaded separately in the prescribed formats. Selection includes a shorthand test and interview. Eligible candidates will be informed about tests through SMS, email and the official court recruitment website. No travel allowance will be paid for attending the selection tests. Candidates must preserve their submitted application and payment receipt until completion of the recruitment process. Providing false or incomplete details may result in cancellation of candidature or appointment.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification announces 3 Stenographer Grade-III posts , including two vacancies in the general recruitment column and one vacancy earmarked for a woman candidate. The reservation distribution is provided in the Kannada notification. Candidates claiming reservation must possess the applicable valid certificates and satisfy the relevant Karnataka Government reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 General Instructions PDF
content_sections.text: The court has also issued a separate general instructions document for Stenographer Grade-III applicants. It includes the required shorthand and typewriting qualifications, photograph and signature specifications, important dates, application requirements and document verification checklist. Official General Instructions PDF: Download Stenographer Grade-III General Instructions

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru South District, Ramanagara, issued Notification No. ADM/18/2026 dated 28 October 2026 for the recruitment of three Stenographer Grade-III posts. The official Kannada notification contains the vacancy distribution, qualifications, age limits, salary, selection rules, application fees and registration instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download Ramanagara District Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 Notification

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the PUC examination or an equivalent qualification and the prescribed Senior Grade shorthand and typewriting examinations in both Kannada and English. Important: Candidates must possess the required Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting examination qualifications. Applicants should keep all relevant marks cards and qualification certificates ready for verification. The Kannada notification also refers to the computer knowledge requirements applicable under Karnataka Government service rules. Candidates should check the relevant computer literacy and examination provisions in the official notification before applying.

rows.qualification: Prescribed Government Examining Authority or Recognized Equivalent

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years . The upper age limit differs by category, with additional relaxation available under applicable Government orders. Special Age Relaxation: The notification refers to an additional five-year upper-age relaxation under the applicable Karnataka Government order. This benefit is subject to the notification's conditions and applicable recruitment rules. Further relaxations may apply to eligible Ex-Servicemen, Government servants and other categories under the relevant Karnataka Judicial Service recruitment provisions.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Stenographer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive the notified pay scale of Rs. 44,425 to Rs. 83,700 along with applicable Government allowances. The stated pay scale is basic pay progression, not a guaranteed in-hand salary.

rows.details: Allowances as Admissible under Applicable Rules

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 200 for General Merit candidates and Rs. 100 for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B candidates . The notified exempt categories do not need to pay the fee. Fee Payment Last Date: 1 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Payment Mode: Online through SBI e-Pay, Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI using the official application portal. Fees paid through an unauthorized method will not be accepted. The notification states that application fees once paid will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Stenographer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the prescribed qualifying shorthand test followed by an interview , subject to eligibility and document verification. Application Scrutiny: Verification of the prescribed PUC, shorthand, typewriting and other eligibility requirements. Shorthand Test: Separate Kannada and English shorthand assessment using the prescribed dictation and transcription procedure. Interview: Candidates qualifying under the applicable shorthand test rules will be considered for interview. Document Verification: Original qualifications and reservation certificates must be produced when requested. Final Selection: Preparation of selection results according to the notified recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Stenographer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes a practical shorthand examination in Kannada and English. The test assesses the candidate's ability to take dictation and transcribe the material using the prescribed computer-based procedure. The Kannada notification states that shorthand dictation is to be conducted separately in Kannada and English. Eligible candidates will be considered for interview according to their qualifying performance and the recruitment rules. The notification also provides applicable provisions for candidates requiring assistance under disability-related rules.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit applications for the Stenographer Grade-III posts from 30 October 2026 until 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Apply Online: Ramanagara District Court Stenographer Online Application Official Recruitment Notices: District Court Bengaluru South / Ramanagara Recruitment Page Applications submitted through post, courier or other offline methods will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment website at ramanagara.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/ . Locate Notification No. ADM/18/2026 for Stenographer Grade-III. Download the recruitment notification and general instructions. Confirm that you satisfy the PUC, Kannada and English shorthand, and typewriting qualifications. Open the Stenographer Grade-III online application link . Enter the required personal details, mobile number, educational qualifications and other application information. Select the applicable reservation category and enter the supporting certificate information, if required. Upload the prescribed photograph and signature in the specified formats. Review the entered details carefully before submitting the application. Submit the online application by 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Pay the application fee, if applicable, through the prescribed online payment facility by 1 December 2026 . Download or print the completed application and payment receipt for future reference. Important: Applicants must submit correct information. Incomplete applications, incorrect category claims and missing prescribed qualifications may result in rejection.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The official general instructions specify separate JPG uploads for the candidate's photograph and signature. Candidates should follow the current online form's validation instructions while preparing the image files.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must keep original certificates and one set of photocopies ready for verification. Reservation certificates should have been obtained from the competent authority before the application closing date. Printed copy of the submitted online application form. Application fee payment receipt, if applicable. SSLC certificate and marks card. 2nd PUC or equivalent qualification certificate. Kannada and English Shorthand marks cards. Kannada and English Typewriting marks cards or recognized equivalent. Valid caste certificate, if claiming reservation. No Objection Certificate for serving candidates, where required. Ex-Serviceman discharge certificate, where applicable. Rural reservation certificate, where applicable. Kannada Medium certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate from the competent authority, if applicable. Project Displaced Person certificate, if claiming the applicable benefit. All original certificates and the required photocopies must be produced at the time of document verification. Claims supported by certificates obtained after the application closing date may not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Ramanagara District Court Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted. The recruitment is for 3 Stenographer Grade-III posts. Applicants must have passed PUC or equivalent. Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting qualifications are mandatory. Online applications close on 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The last date for online fee payment is 1 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Applicants must provide a valid mobile number for communication. Photograph and signature must be uploaded separately in the prescribed formats. Selection includes a shorthand test and interview. Eligible candidates will be informed about tests through SMS, email and the official court recruitment website. No travel allowance will be paid for attending the selection tests. Candidates must preserve their submitted application and payment receipt until completion of the recruitment process. Providing false or incomplete details may result in cancellation of candidature or appointment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by District Court Ramanagara for filling up vacant positions under the state judicial department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Stenographer Grade-III under the current recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Stenographer Grade-III post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or SSLC with Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand and typewriting, along with computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for general category candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years for general category candidates, with relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, Cat-1, and PWD categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 30 October 2026 for eligible and interested job seekers.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30 November 2026 up to the specified closing hours.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Shorthand and Typing Skill Test followed by a Viva-voce interview round.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal of District Court Ramanagara at https://ramanagara.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/.
